PRJ-2 — Implementation And Verification Record

Purpose And Retention

This retained companion records the detailed implementation and verification evidence for PRJ-2 — Projects Customisation And Apple Notes Migration Delivery. PRJ-2 remains the outcome, contract, checkpoint, and status authority. Current code, config, tests, and durable architecture remain behavior authority.

Unlike an ordinary temporary working-notes document, this record is retained after closeout because its exact file scope, migration inventory, estimates, deviations, and evidence are expected to remain useful. It is not a chronology or a substitute for current architecture documentation.

Current State

PRJ-2.1 is manually accepted: Nerve saves and projects its Folder Link, Open in Finder and Open in VS Code work, and the Projects list and Manage manifest update. PRJ-2.2 migration tooling is implemented and awaiting checkpoint review. No real migration plan artifact, Project source/media import, or apply has started.

PRJ-2.0 Contract Freeze

Delivery Boundary

PRJ-2 remains two implementation slices after this freeze:

slice bounded outcome
PRJ-2.1 one registered Manage-only Projects customisation owns source validation, Edit Metadata, Manage-manifest projection, row/detail presentation, and exact Open in Finder
PRJ-2.2 one checked-in command plans and applies the exact dated Apple Notes corpus through the shared per-document normalization, media, creation, and rebuild owners

PRJ-2.3 runs the real plan/apply and records its evidence. PRJ-2.0 changes no product behavior and performs no collection or media writes.

Current Owner Trace

The ordinary package dispatcher is not the migration owner. It requires one Markdown file below data-sharing and rejects a folder with several Markdown files. The migration instead invokes the shared per-file helpers against the fixed dated export. A narrow optional sanitized provenance-label input will remove the current data-sharing display-path assumption from the shared media plan helper; it will not broaden ordinary Import discovery or path authority.

Frozen Projects Customisation Contract

  • The selected ID is dotlineform_projects; its settings object is strict and empty. It is registered for Manage only.
  • Source front matter owns either no field or one scalar decoded relative path, such as folder_path: projects/architecture. The PRJ-1 grammar rejects an empty segment, ., .., absolute stored values, backslashes, control characters, and schemes.
  • Metadata Save accepts the stored relative form or normalizes an absolute POSIX/Finder path, local file: URL, or shell-display escaped absolute path. Blank removes the field. Markdown and dlf-local: representations fail.
  • The exact source read and successful save response expose only record.customisation.folder_path. The request customisation object accepts exactly folder_path; unknown fields and use on another collection fail.
  • manage-manifest.json adds only the same decoded value to the exact row as customisation.folder_path. Its root descriptor is {"id":"dotlineform_projects","data":{}}. A pathless row has no row customisation value.
  • The public manifest remains byte-compatible {doc_id, title} data and the public registry has no Projects loader.
  • The browser contribution mounts one native text input labelled Folder Link. It performs no paste interception, clipboard write, execCommand, fake Undo, or paste status messaging.
  • Save retains the shared modal lifecycle: the modal closes before the asynchronous server mutation. A rejected invalid or out-of-root value makes no source change and is reported through the existing Manage error surface.
  • Rows show the exact path, no-link state, and duplicate use computed from the loaded manifest. The detail action submits only that row's exact path to the existing local-target client.
  • PRJ-2.1 does not scan current folders or add folder_exists. A stored link is valid whether current, missing, or prospective. Project State later owns existence classification; explicit Open in Finder may return missing.

The additive metadata contribution contract is deliberately smaller than a custom-field schema: the selected registered module may mount one editor into the detached host, return its strict payload on Save, and destroy it on close. The shared modal still owns its existing fixed fields and lifecycle.

Frozen Migration Plan Contract

The command is fixed to:

source:      $DOTLINEFORM_PROJECTS_BASE_DIR/Notes export - 2026-05-18/iCloud/dotlineform/projects
folders:     $DOTLINEFORM_PROJECTS_BASE_DIR/projects (direct children only)
destination: {scope: dotlineform, sub_scope: projects}

It has explicit --plan, --apply, and --validate modes. The local ignored artifact directory is:

var/docs/dotlineform-project-notes-migration/
  folder-mapping.json
  plan.json
  plan-report.md
  receipt.json
  result-report.md

folder-mapping.json is the only reviewer-edited artifact. Exact folder-name matches are recorded as exact_match. Every unmatched exported top-level folder starts as review_required and must become either an explicit mapped target or no_current_folder. There is no normalization or fuzzy match. The planner refuses to emit plan.json while a decision is outstanding.

Once mapping is complete, the first final plan allocates and records all identities and is create-only. Re-running --plan validates the existing plan; it does not replace it or allocate new identities. Replacing a reviewed plan is an explicit operator action outside the command.

The plan schema is dotlineform_project_notes_migration_v1 and records:

  • exact collection and marker-rooted input/output identities;
  • one operation timestamp shared by all records and one recorded allocate_doc_id result per Markdown file, ordered by case-folded export-relative path;
  • every Markdown relative path and SHA-256, normalized title/body preview, target source path and SHA-256, and accepted/pathless mapping decision;
  • every referenced asset relative path, input SHA-256, supported/unsupported classification, owning document, deterministic target filename, media class, and conversion plan;
  • hashes of the export inventory, direct current-folder inventory, mapping, pre-existing Project source inventory, and canonical plan payload;
  • all preserved missing, unsupported, already-normalized, applenotes:, and sandbox: references plus summary counts; and
  • explicit readiness, blockers, and untouched existing document records.

Title selection reuses the ordinary order: first H1, then scalar ordinary front matter title, then humanized Markdown filename stem. The current snapshot has an H1 in all 240 Markdown files and no front matter. Duplicate titles remain valid. Every Markdown file creates one document even when several files share an exported folder, and all may share its reviewed folder_path.

The plan file retains normalized Markdown previews because apply must consume the exact reviewed conversion and media filenames rather than reallocate them. It remains under ignored local var/; plan-report.md is the sanitized human review surface and the retained Studio companion records only hashes, counts, exceptions, and deviations.

Frozen Apply And Resume Contract

The write-free real plan does not require watcher shutdown. Immediately before an accepted real apply, PRJ-2.3 quiesces the Docs live rebuild watcher through its owning local service and records that neither the watcher nor a Docs build is active. The Tags bootstrap left its watcher running and it regenerated payloads during the seed; PRJ-2 must not repeat that behavior because this contract commits the complete batch before one migration-owned rebuild.

Apply first rehashes the complete input, mapping, current-folder snapshot, and every untouched pre-existing collection source. Current collection inventory may differ from the baseline only by byte-identical targets owned by this plan; an unplanned addition, removal, or change stops the run. Apply then prepares every planned media output and invokes the existing media owner's complete-set write-free preflight. Before any write, all source targets must be absent or byte-identical planned resume targets, and all media targets must be absent or byte-identical. Any other source, media, inventory, or plan collision stops the run.

Each not-yet-committed record then follows the shared order:

stored ImportContent + stored preview/media plan
  -> plan_import_document with recorded ID and timestamp
  -> verify projected source SHA-256
  -> materialize supported media
  -> write_text_atomic_new exact source
  -> atomically advance receipt

receipt.json is bound to the plan revision and records exact per-document media/source completion and hashes plus rebuild state. A retry recognizes only byte-identical targets named by the plan, whether or not the previous process advanced the receipt before stopping. Mismatched content is never adopted. No retry reparses targets, allocates an identity, chooses another filename, or deduplicates by title/body.

After every plan target is exact, apply invokes the existing confined child rebuild once. A rebuild failure leaves committed media and sources in place and records rebuild: failed; a repeated --apply skips exact committed targets and retries the rebuild only. --validate checks plan, receipt, source, media, and generated manifest agreement without writes.

The watcher remains quiesced across a resumable partial failure; restarting it would publish an intermediate collection outside the migration receipt. After apply, the owned rebuild, and --validate all succeed, PRJ-2.3 restores the previously running watcher/service and verifies its health. An operator may choose a different recovery only explicitly and records the resulting visible state.

The result report retains current direct folders grouped by zero/one/many associated Project documents, pathless imports, explicit unmatched decisions, untouched pre-existing documents, and unresolved link/asset exceptions. It does not create or repair gaps.

Audited Corpus Snapshot

The trace reconfirmed 240 Markdown files in 201 exported top-level folders and 206 current direct projects/ folders. Nineteen export folders contain more than one Markdown file; the largest currently contains fourteen.

The shared parser currently recognizes 344 supported referenced assets:

class count planned handling
raster images 328 per-document *-image-NN.webp, maximum width 800, never upscale
allowed attachments 16 per-document *-attachment-NN.<ext>, bytes preserved
RTF 1 link text retained, no copy, exception reported
TXT 1 link text retained, no copy, exception reported

The link audit also found 1 applenotes:, 9 sandbox:, 27 http:, 44 https:, and one already-normalized Docs media token. External links remain links. The token is preserved; it is not resolved relative to the export or allocated another media target.

Rough Diff Estimate

slice production tests signal
PRJ-2.1 550-750 lines 450-650 lines one field, one registered server/browser adapter, one narrow modal host
PRJ-2.2 650-850 lines 450-650 lines fixed migration orchestration, plan/receipt/report shaping, and resume checks
total 1,200-1,600 lines 900-1,300 lines excludes delivery docs, generated Studio projections, real migrated sources/media, and local plan artifacts

The migration is the larger part. Crossing 1,600 production lines, changing the shared report engine, or adding UI/routes is a stop-and-review signal, not permission to compress validation or duplicate existing owners.

Verification Plan

PRJ-2.1 requires focused Python tests above, both named smoke scripts, the public import-graph check, Docs Viewer source lint, a confined Projects build, inspection of public and Manage manifests, realistic list/detail/Edit Metadata review, native paste/Undo review, and git diff --check.

PRJ-2.2 requires the focused migration/import tests and a temporary fixture apply before the real export. PRJ-2.3 then runs the real --plan, records its plan revision and inventory counts here, reviews every unmatched decision and representative multi-note/odd-name/exception record, and stops for explicit apply approval. Before apply it records the owning watcher/service state, quiesces that service, and proves no watcher/build remains active. Post-apply evidence distinguishes source/media commit, generated projection, watcher restoration/health, and manual UI acceptance.

Risks And Explicit Omissions

  • The plan contains normalized private note bodies. It stays in ignored local var/; only the sanitized reports and summary evidence are copied here.
  • Cloud Drive availability and Pillow 12.0.0 are operational prerequisites. Changed input bytes or conversion environment stop apply rather than drift.
  • A crash may leave an exact prefix of media/sources committed. The receipt and byte comparison make that state resumable; PRJ-2 does not promise rollback.
  • Duplicate titles, duplicate paths, existing similar documents, and pathless documents are intentional review states, not collisions.
  • Unsupported and special links may remain nonfunctional after import. They are preserved and reported, not guessed or silently removed.
  • The one existing Project document is baseline inventory only. Migration does not add its Folder Link or merge it with an exported note.
  • IFS-1 owns any later arbitrary-folder picker and remembered Import source.
  • Project State owns current/missing/prospective classification and zero/one/ many reconciliation. PRJ-2 only supplies source metadata and a retained gap report.

PRJ-2.0 Review Checkpoint

The frozen contract covers:

  • a manually created document saved with a prospective contained path;
  • an existing exact document gaining or removing a Folder Link;
  • several imported documents sharing one reviewed path;
  • an explicitly unmatched pathless import;
  • RTF/TXT, applenotes:, sandbox:, and already-normalized reference cases;
  • an untouched existing collection document; and
  • a post-commit rebuild failure that retries generation without another create.

No implementation begins until this checkpoint is accepted.

Implementation Record

PRJ-2.1

The implemented production scope follows the frozen source-to-projection workflow:

  • dotlineform/projects selects the strict, empty-settings dotlineform_projects customisation. The server registry restricts it to that exact collection and exposes controlled source-validation, projection, metadata-read, and metadata-save callbacks.
  • the source and builder models retain and validate optional decoded relative folder_path; the Manage projector adds only the root descriptor and exact per-document row value;
  • exact metadata reads and revision-bound saves hydrate, normalize, write, or remove the field. Folder Link-only changes preserve the existing body/title/summary last_updated rule;
  • the new Manage browser module owns the native Folder Link input, row path or no-link state, duplicate count, and exact Open in Finder action; and
  • the public registry and public {doc_id, title} manifest remain unchanged.

Two small production files not named in the frozen proposed list changed: docs_scope_config.py enforces the exact collection restriction, and docs-viewer-management-subscope-composition.js supplies the already-loaded document list for duplicate projection. The generated Manage browser config also changed as the expected consequence of the source registry selection. The proposed import-front-matter callback remains deferred to PRJ-2.2, where document creation needs it.

The production diff is 714 additions and 30 deletions, excluding tests, delivery documents, generated browser config, and external-local generated payloads. The test diff is 781 additions and 6 deletions. The larger-than- estimated test portion is concentrated in retained end-to-end browser contract coverage; it adds no product capability.

PRJ-2.2

The checked-in migrate_dotlineform_project_notes.py command now owns the fixed-source --plan, --apply, and --validate workflow. Planning creates a strict reviewer-owned mapping, blocks on every unmatched export folder, then freezes one timestamp, one create-only identity per case-folded Markdown path, normalized private previews, exact source/media hashes, provenance, baseline inventories, a canonical plan revision, and a sanitized report. Re-running plan validates that frozen record without reallocating.

Apply rehashes the export, mapping, current folders, and collection baseline; checks every planned source target; converts the complete supported media set for one write-free collision preflight; and only then advances an atomic, plan-bound receipt per exact document. It recognizes byte-identical targets when a crash precedes the receipt, refuses mismatches, and retries only the sub-scope rebuild after a recorded post-commit rebuild failure. Validate is write-free and checks plan, receipt, sources, media, and both generated manifests.

The shared import seam gained only two narrow capabilities: a registered sub-scope customisation may validate create-only front matter, used here solely for Projects folder_path; and Markdown-package media provenance may use a sanitized caller-supplied marker label while ordinary Import keeps its current default workspace behavior. The former completes responsibility already allocated to the PRJ-2.1 Projects customisation and registry; it is not a new field system.

The production diff is 1,307 additions and 2 deletions; 1,197 additions are the deliberately explicit one-off migration command. Tests add 432 lines. No route, UI, import lister, shared report engine, Project document, migration artifact, or real migration media changed.

Verification Record

PRJ-2.1

  • focused Python coverage: 93 tests passed across config, path normalization, source validation, builder projection, metadata read/save/remove, and public runtime boundaries;
  • adjacent mutation and reviewed-package regressions: 36 tests passed;
  • both required browser smokes passed: docs_viewer_subscope_report_modules.py and docs_viewer_service_manage.py;
  • explicit changed-file Python and JavaScript lint passed, followed by the complete Docs Viewer source lint;
  • recorded docs-viewer-smoke profile prj-2-1-projects-customisation-permitted passed 25 of 25 checks. The first sandboxed attempt failed only because localhost binding was denied; the permitted rerun is the product result;
  • the confined real dotlineform/projects build reported one document, no document writes or removals, and one Manage-manifest write. The public manifest remains the minimal Nerve {doc_id, title} row; the Manage manifest adds only {"id":"dotlineform_projects","data":{}}, while the pathless Nerve row has no row customisation; and
  • the generated Manage browser config exposes the Projects descriptor and the public config remained unchanged.

The native input has no paste, clipboard, beforeinput, or execCommand handler; automation exercised its mount/read/destroy contract. Real visual density and native paste were manually accepted. Nerve's Folder Link was added; Open in Finder and Open in VS Code work; and the exact Manage manifest and list updated. Native Undo remains deliberately browser-owned with no fake Undo or execCommand. No imported note, migration plan, or migration media was created or changed in PRJ-2.1.

PRJ-2.2

  • 25 focused import/migration tests passed. The temporary external-local corpus covers incomplete mapping, deterministic identity and title fallback, multiple notes sharing a path, explicit pathless output, PNG-to-WebP and attachment handling, missing/unsupported/sandbox: exceptions, no-write planning, complete-set media collision refusal, mismatched source refusal, receipt-lag recovery, and rebuild-only retry followed by write-free validate;
  • 99 adjacent tests passed across scope config, sub-scope building, source validation, metadata, ordinary import planning/media, and the migration;
  • explicit changed-file Ruff and the complete maintained Docs Viewer Python and JavaScript lint boundary passed;
  • the migration CLI help exposes exactly --plan, --apply, --validate, and --repo-root; the local artifact root is covered by the repository's ignored var/ rule; and
  • a read-only process audit confirmed that the Docs live rebuild watcher remained running while no Docs build/search command remained active; it was not quiesced in PRJ-2.2; and
  • git diff --check passed before the delivery-document projection rebuild.

This evidence is fixture-only. It proves the command's safety and resume contracts, not the contents or outcome of the real 240-document corpus. The real write-free plan, mapping review, watcher shutdown before accepted apply, real apply/validate, watcher restoration, and UI density review remain PRJ-2.3.
